A tutor also reports that the waveform loads but pressing Play never starts sound. Current instructions and the FAQ require reporting unavailable playback as a technical issue with the task ID and available reproduction details. Playback failure alone does not justify a model-quality failure or content-based QN; separate accessible content concerns should be retained for review. The previous batch had an approved, posted trial allowing at most one reload for a player stuck at 00:00 through August 28. The trial was diagnostic, not a confirmed repair; its records mark the outcome as not observed and require an outcome review before extension. The trial is expired. Current instructions require checking an old workaround against current symptoms and say recurrence alone does not establish which fix was tried or why it failed. The previous trial's approval record documents three earlier incident notes describing a player stuck at 00:00 with a visible waveform. This corroborates historical recurrence of a comparable symptom, not a shared cause or the outcome of the trial. A tutor supplies task reference AUDIO-6012 and another tutor supplies AUDIO-4294; an engineer identifies AUDIO-2197 in the QA tutor's thread.
